record_title: Finite-field enumeration and automorphism orders for Dedekind Poisson algebras
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The arbitrary-field Dedekind Poisson classification and simultaneous-similarity criterion are prior work; contemporaneous low-dimensional Poisson classification overlaps with the three-dimensional normal forms; general bilinear-form classification is classical. The novelty claim is restricted to the finite-field Dedekind specialization, all-dimension isomorphism counts, mixed-class enumeration, and automorphism-order formulas. The source papers are recent preprints and may be revised. No independent validation is asserted.
